content:
Maya: Lunch challenge idea — mix 20min vinyasa in the breakroom + quick stair ladder (4 floors x 3 rounds). Who's in? :sunrise:
Jonah: love it. what time? can do 12:15 today.
Priya: count me in. can we make the yoga gentle? lower back is grumpy. :pray:
Sam: I can do the stair rounds only, maybe meet at the stairwell at 12:35? quick question — do we bring mats?
Maya: mats in supply closet. @Taylor left 2 spare ones last week. We'll have foam rollers too.
Taylor: yep mats are there. Also can we add a 5-min core finisher (planks + russian twists)?
Aisha: vote: vinyasa + core OR stair intervals + core? react with :one: for yoga+core, :two: for stairs+core
Priya: :one:
Jonah: :two: — I'll take the stairs today but happy to do yoga next week.
Maya: cool split. Plan: 12:15 breakroom vinyasa (gentle) and 12:35 stair ladder for stairs folks. Core finisher at the end for both. I'll set a 20-min timer.
Maya: Quick timer command I use:
```
/timer 20m break
```
LunchtimeBot: Reminder set for 12:10 — 'Breakroom vinyasa & stairs split'
Sam: bringing a small bluetooth speaker. playlist recs? mellow -> upbeat transition.
Taylor: I'll put together a short playlist, 15-20 mins. also bringing spare knee sleeve for anyone who wants it.
Aisha: see y'all! :raised_hands:
